title: Problem-Solving Meeting
subtitle: Team discussion about missed deadlines — for English learners

sentences.en: Thanks everyone for joining. I called this meeting because we've missed three deadlines this quarter.
sentences.target: Thanks everyone for joining. I called this meeting because we've missed three deadlines this quarter.

sentences.en: Before we get into solutions, I want to understand what's actually causing the delays.
sentences.target: Before we get into solutions, I want to understand what's actually causing the delays.

sentences.en: Honestly, our scope keeps expanding mid-project, and we don't update our timelines accordingly.
sentences.target: Honestly, our scope keeps expanding mid-project, and we don't update our timelines accordingly.

sentences.en: That's a fair point. Would it help if we required formal change requests for any new feature?
sentences.target: That's a fair point. Would it help if we required formal change requests for any new feature?

sentences.en: Yes, but only if leadership actually pushes back when those requests aren't justified.
sentences.target: Yes, but only if leadership actually pushes back when those requests aren't justified.

sentences.en: I also think we underestimate how much time we lose to unscheduled meetings each week.
sentences.target: I also think we underestimate how much time we lose to unscheduled meetings each week.

sentences.en: We could try blocking out two days a week as 'no-meeting' days to give people focused work time.
sentences.target: We could try blocking out two days a week as 'no-meeting' days to give people focused work time.

sentences.en: I'd be willing to pilot that with my team for the next sprint and see how it goes.
sentences.target: I'd be willing to pilot that with my team for the next sprint and see how it goes.

sentences.en: Let's also revisit our estimation process — I think we're being too optimistic by default.
sentences.target: Let's also revisit our estimation process — I think we're being too optimistic by default.

sentences.en: Agreed. Adding a buffer of twenty percent to all estimates might be a good place to start.
sentences.target: Agreed. Adding a buffer of twenty percent to all estimates might be a good place to start.

sentences.en: Great discussion. I'll write up these action items and send them out by end of day.
sentences.target: Great discussion. I'll write up these action items and send them out by end of day.
